title: review follow-ups of PR #37706: lint a lookup dependsOn param that names a field its target cannot filter on; skip the unscoped probe when no scoped read answered
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① (review follow-ups, one card per PR) · Source: fleet (Contract review records 7204641031 and 7205472092 on PR #37706, nits N2 and N4, adopted at ACCEPT; PR-1 #37567's nit 2)

## What happens

PR #37706 (Fixes #36794, PR-2) makes an import of a lookup value outside the row's scope answer in the reader's language, and answers a scope that cannot be queried with its own sentence at run time. Two items stay open:

- [ ] **Nothing tells the author before import that a scope cannot work** (N2; the lint half of PR-1 #37567's nit 2). A lookup whose `dependsOn` entry points its `param` at a field the target cannot be filtered on (a formula or other non-stored field) publishes clean, and every import then fails that column with "no matching record". Expected: a producer-side lint on the lookup's `dependsOn.param` naming the target field and why. This refuses metadata that publishes today, so it is a narrowing: grade it and declare it as one.
- [ ] **The unscoped probe can still run when no scoped read answered** (N4). When every scoped read was refused for the scope cell's value (`INVALID_FILTER`), `referenceNotFound` still probes unscoped and can answer `reference_out_of_scope`. Same as `main`. Expected: skip the probe whenever no scoped read answered, and align the `validation-message.ts` jsdoc, changeset wording and docs line ("any other refusal keeps the plain sentence").

Category ①: an import refusal that names the wrong cause, and an authoring mistake found only at import.
Priority: p2.
Business reason: an admin importing records sees every row of a column refused without being told the lookup's setup is the cause, and an app author is not warned when they set it up.
Reader: the data-lane dev who next edits the import runner or the lookup lint rules.
Dedupe: searched open issues for `"PR #37706"`: 0 hits.
Related: #36794, PR #37567, PR #37706.

## Grade

area:data · Bug · minor · reach: read (the head against `main`) · evidence: read → p2
